title: Myrna Hansen hypnotic regression and underground facility abduction
summary: Greg Bishop tells of Myrna Hansen hypnotic regression and underground facility abduction, about c. 1980 at Sandia National Laboratories, Albuquerque, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: the woman MNA Hansen that she he had coming to his house in the 80s talking about she was talking about being abducted and going to this underground facility

plain: Greg Bishop, a researcher and author, tells of a woman named Myrna Hansen who, in the 1980s, kept visiting the house of a man named Paul Bennewitz in Albuquerque, New Mexico. Bishop says she talked about being abducted and taken to an underground facility. The title links her story to hypnotic regression, where a hypnotist tries to recover hidden memories, and Bishop names a counselor called Leo Sprinkle, along with Sandia National Laboratories, a US government research lab near the city. If true, it would point to a secret underground base tied to abductions.
